answer: Scarce Beacon Registry: each identity must periodically submit a unique, physically measured environmental plume from a certified sensor it exclusively possesses, geolocated and time-stamped. A single operator cannot fake two simultaneous readings from distant locations without owning two sensors, so the haven of colluding identities collapses. Duplicate or synthesized plumes are rejected via cross-correlation. The yarrow test is a shared randomness challenge signed by each sensor’s hardware key. Cost: one certified sensor, deployment, and calibration per identity.
